verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any native bulk or batch feature, such as bulk actions, looping over item lists, or batch API endpoints. Running arbitrary Node.js or Python code in workflows is only a developer building block from which bulk processing could be built, so it earns no credit. Bulk operations are a fair axis for a workflow automation platform, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
